name: Reaction Content
description: First-react, then-analyze format — initial visceral reaction, deeper analysis, final take. Best for reacting to news, other creators' content, trending videos, industry drama, and 'I saw this so you don't have to' content.
voice_style: energetic initial reaction, then more measured and analytical — shifts energy: loud/visceral reaction → thoughtful analysis → calm authoritative takeaway
music_mood: dramatic sting for reaction moment, beat drop for punchline, clean background music under analysis sections

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Everyone is sharing this and nobody is talking about what I just saw. I need 60 seconds of your time because this changes something.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person holding phone up showing video to camera, shocked expression, phone screen visible in frame, hand gesturing in disbelief, text overlay 'WAIT WHAT'
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up, phone-in-frame composition, energetic reaction gestures
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: phone screen glow as primary light source, ring light fill on face, dark room aesthetic
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Dark room + phone screen aesthetic is the reaction genre signature; shock expression must be clear and readable at medium shot

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: My initial reaction: I genuinely gasped. [Brief description of what was seen without spoiling too much]. I watched it three times to make sure I wasn't misunderstanding. I wasn't.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person's face cycling through genuine reaction expressions — shock, confusion, processing, nodding, split screen showing video playing and person watching, phone or screen recording aesthetic
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up static, cut to split-screen composition, steady on face
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: phone screen glow dominant, slightly brighter fill than hook for clarity, warm face tones
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Expression cycling is the content — expressions must be genuine and readable; split screen adds production value

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: But here's what nobody is talking about. The real story here is not what happened — it's why it happened. [Analysis point one]. And separately — [analysis point two]. This is actually part of a pattern that [expert or contextual observation].
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person shifting energy — more serious expression, graphic appearing behind them with key analysis points, bullet points materializing, person gesturing while explaining, more studio-lit professional look
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up, steady professional framing, slight push-in on key insight beats
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: professional studio two-point lighting, cooler authoritative tones, clean background
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Lighting shift signals energy shift — brighter and more professional signals 'analyst mode'; graphics should be clean and brand-consistent

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Final take: This is either a turning point or a distraction. I'm leaning toward turning point. But we will know more in six months. Bookmark this and come back.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person giving final direct-to-camera statement, confident energy, screen showing calendar or countdown graphic, person tapping temple 'remember this moment', assured expression
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up, confident steady hold, subtle push-in on 'turning point'
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm authoritative light, confident and assured tones, slightly warmer than analysis section
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Final take is authority moment — steady confident framing; calendar/countdown graphic plants 'come back' hook

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Do you agree? Drop your take in the comments — I read everything. Follow for more reactions and breakdowns.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person pointing at comment section, debate-style prompt, person smiling, follow button visible, comment icon pulsing
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up, energetic but warm CTA
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm friendly energy, inviting community feel
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Debate prompt energy — this should feel like an invitation to a conversation, not a broadcast
